definitions.current_manager: Manager in the latest manager-coded club game strictly before signing.
definitions.formation_shape: Leading numeric formation shape; textual modifiers such as Attacking, Defending, flat, Diamond, or double 6 are removed.
definitions.manager_identity: Unicode-normalized manager name recorded for each club-game.
definitions.manager_transition: Latest change in adjacent manager-coded club games during the prior-year window.
definitions.no_manager_transition: Transition indicator is zero, days-since is one, and role-change fields are structural zero when manager coverage passes and no change is observed.
definitions.observed_manager_spell: Consecutive manager-coded games at the end of the prior-year window with the current manager; not an official employment tenure.

interpretation_boundary.formation_features: Reported base-shape stability, not full tactical intent or in-match tactical changes.
interpretation_boundary.manager_features: Observed match-record stability, not appointment-contract tenure or causal manager quality.
interpretation_boundary.player_manager_features: Observed role under a manager, not a causal manager preference effect.

zero_semantics.no_manager_change: Zero role-change fields mean no observed transition, distinguished by manager_transition_observed_365d.
zero_semantics.player_not_selected: Zero player rate is accepted only when current-manager lineup and appearance game coverage passes the source gate.
zero_semantics.stable_formation: Zero formation change or distribution shift is valid only after formation coverage passes.
